raw_reason: Duplication of Content through Error by Journal/Publisher
canonical_reason: Duplication of Content through Error by Journal/Publisher
definition_used: Duplication of published content due to an error by the journal or publisher.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes duplication of published content caused by a journal/publisher error. This directly involves editorial and production governance (editorial_peer_review_governance) and post-publication correction/transparency processes (post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight). The problem object is the article as a whole, and the process signals are journal error and duplication handling.
